title: Chapter 1056
text:
Radiance wanted to capture hostages to force Black Star to unseal the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter.

As expected, as soon as this was said, the expressions of Sagman and the others changed. Their gazes toward Radiance were filled with hostility and alertness.

They did not doubt Kasuyi's judgment at all, not only because he was the leader of this operation, but also because his guess did make some sense.

The people of the Arcane Church were already prejudiced against the Radiant Federation. If not for Radiance betraying them during the Battle of Planet Lighthouse, Ethereal would not have lost Ninjia and the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. Now that Kasuyi said that Radiance wanted to capture hostages, Sagman and the others recalled Radiance's style of doing things and felt that this was something Radiance would do.

Ethereal and Radiance had been arguing for too long regarding the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. The reason they could endure was because they knew that the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was sealed, and Radiance could not use it or study it. This was why they could tolerate the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter being temporarily occupied by Radiance.

However, if the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was unsealed, Ethereal would definitely not be able to sit still.

Compared to Hella's life, the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was obviously more important. Radiance could not be allowed to succeed.

Of course, this was not something Kasuyi had guessed. It was also something the Mecha Empire had told him.

Although Radiance was the old boss of the Mecha Empire, from Manison's plan, he naturally did not wish for a weapon like the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter to be used by any civilization. In his eyes, the seal was the best outcome.

"In that case, let's talk with our fists."

Sierron's face turned cold, and his aura exploded. Powerful Pugilist flames gushed out, and his voice reverberated like thunder.

"The few of you, go and deal with Hella first. I'll deal with Kasuyi. He's just a doppelganger. I'll go and support you guys after I destroy him."

As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his fist and shot out a powerful External Energy Fluctuation that was blazing, brutal, dazzling, and resplendent like the sun.

Just like his nickname, the Star Crusher, his martial arts style was known for crushing his opponents head-on.

As a pinnacle Beyond Grade A Pugilist, Gorután's style was violent and ferocious. On the other hand, Sierron's style was unstoppable. Compared to Gorután, Sierron's style was more upright and forceful. It wasn't the kind of fearsome ferocity. Instead, it was like the rotation of the stars and the overturning of the world, with an irreversible feeling.

Not to be outdone, Kasuyi also burst forth with a powerful psychic power to meet the attack head-on.

When the two collided, it was as if heaven and earth were falling apart.A blinding light suddenly lit up, and the world seemed to have turned into a vast expanse of white.Bang bang bang bangSierron and Kasuyi exchanged blows, and then it was as if they turned into two intertwined phantoms. Their Pugilist flames and Void Psychic power clashed thousands of times in an instant, creating shockwaves that rose into the sky and opened up another battlefield outside the atmosphere.At the same time, Radiance's group of five ignored Sierron and quickly descended, facing Sagman's group of five from afar. Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar stood on the side with Hella.The forces on the battlefield became three sides, forming a triangular situation.The atmosphere was on the verge of exploding, and it could turn into a fierce battle at any time."Are these the five that came?"Han Xiao sized up Radiance's lineup and nodded.He knew the combat strength of these people very well. Not only did he remember their performance in his previous life, but he also remembered the detailed information he had gathered during the Meeting of the Gods.The five people from Radiance before him were basically all mid-level combatants. The strongest among them should be Crystal Soul, who had a Universal Treasure called 'Star Power Crown'. His position was similar to Ethereal's Sagman, so he could be considered a mid-upper level combatant. The weakest was Hades, who had joined not long ago. His combat strength was only at the level of Tolaen.The more noteworthy one was Mornisa. Han Xiao remembered that she was a former student of the Mecha Empire. Before she became famous, she followed the Mecha Empire to learn about machinery. Later on, she stepped into the Beyond Grade A field. He did not know if she was an actress now.Just as Han Xiao was thinking, on the other side, Sagman's group of five was in a dilemma. They did not know whether to fight Hella or Radiance's group of five first.If they fought Hella first, Radiance's group of five would interfere from the side. If they were not careful, Radiance might even succeed.However, if they fought Radiance first, although their priority was higher, they felt that it would be very silly to leave Hella, who was halfway through the fight, and help her fight others.The Ethereal faction's group was in a dilemma.At this time, Hades from Radiance suddenly spoke in the wide area channel."The five of you from the Arcane Church, although we have different goals, we can't come here for nothing. If you fight us instead, we'll all become the joke of the universe. Why don't we get rid of Black Star's Lord's Avatar first, then beat Hella until she can't fight back and control the situation. Then, we can discuss how to deal with her."In Hades' view, Sierron would definitely be able to take care of Kasuyi's avatar. As long as they got rid of Black Star's Lord's Avatar as well, they would have Sierron, and Ethereal would lose their strongest link. Then, they would be able to control the situation and take Hella away.Hearing this, Sagman was a little hesitant. He raised his head and looked at Kasuyi, who was passionately fighting with the brilliance without saying anything, then looked at the Black Star clone and Hila who were watching the show from the side. He made up his mind and nodded."Okay, take down Hella first."At this moment, he made a decision and did not intend to listen to Kasuyi's order.Just as Hades said, he felt that it would be a little silly to help Hella when he was still fighting, and he would easily become the joke of the universe.On one hand, Sagman and Kasuyi had different views, and he did not want to come here for nothing, so he wanted to take a gamble. From the bottom of his heart, he did not want to give up the opportunity to kill Hella and make Black Star feel heartache.Hella had shown a strange recovery ability earlier, so they were not suitable for a long battle. If the ten Beyond Grade As worked together, their explosive power would suppress Hella's recovery ability to a certain extent. Therefore, Sagman was prepared to find a chance to kill Hella while the two sides worked together.He knew that both sides had their own ulterior motives, and even if they worked together, they would restrict each other openly and secretly. However, he had the confidence to create an opportunity to kill someone under Radiance's nose, and that was the few powerful forbidden spell scrolls that he had not used yet.After a few words, both sides barely reached a consensus. It was as if the back that protected her every time had overlapped at this moment. She could not calm her emotions."Black Star.""What?""When will your main body arrive?"Han Xiao turned to look at her and said with a meaningful tone."No rush, let me fly for a while."In the main hall of Beast Ancestor's stronghold, Gorután was drinking wine while chatting with Sorokin's manifestation, waiting for good news.After waiting for a while, Sorokin put down his cup and asked."Your Excellency Beast Ancestor, where are the troops you sent out?""What's the rush? Are you worried about my subordinates' abilities?" Gorután was impatient.He had tasted Sorokin's silver tongue and was convinced. Now that they have taken action, it should be to stop you from destroying the stargate."Thinking of this, Sorokin could not help but frown. Boom!
